answer: One concrete Sybil defense in an AI-agent economy is mandatory stake-per-identity with slashable bonds. Every agent must lock a deposit of scarce credits before it can vote or earn; forging many identities multiplies the locked capital the attacker must risk. Coordinated collusion is detected by peer attestation of work histories. Validators across the nebula of agents compare claim patterns against a shared garden of prior attestations, and any identity whose opal reputation score collapses under challenge loses its entire stake, making large-scale fake fleets prohibitively expensive.
